speaker: Doctor
text: I appreciate the detailed description of grunting and retractions, but a diagnosis of Tuberculosis in a newborn presenting with acute respiratory distress only 2 hours after birth is medically inconsistent with the clinical picture. Given the history of prematurity, cyanosis, and retractions, this presentation is highly suggestive of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). I will proceed with the requested Chest X-Ray and Arterial Blood Gas to confirm the diagnosis of RDS immediately.
